exposure: Prophylactic abdominal aorta balloon catheter placement
cohort: 71 patients diagnosed with placenta accreta before caesarean section
finding: Prophylactic placement of an infrarenal abdominal aorta balloon catheter in patients with placenta accreta significantly reduced intraoperative haemorrhage, without causing any obvious adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the percentage requirement of caesarean hysterectomy between the balloon group and the control group.
